evidence.reviewer: codex-main (AI), two separate visual passes, not independent human review
evidence.firstPassMethod: Read original Series A page 1 down each question/key column. Every letter checked visually.
evidence.secondPassMethod: Reopen original rendered page 1 and read across each numbered row. Compare by original question number programmatically.
evidence.authentication: Direct HTTPS download from www.upsc.gov.in, application/pdf, four pages. Header NDA & NA-I Exam-2025, Series A, Subject GAT, 150 questions, zero dropped, 150 taken for scoring. No release date is inferred solely from filename/PDF metadata. Coaching keys are superseded, not adopted as authority.
evidence.subject: GAT

signoff.firstPassMethod: Original cover 1 and English instructions 48; complete English pages 2–11; complete Part B English pages 13–43 odd. All 150 stems and 600 options manually read and transcribed. OCR was an unapproved lead and failed to reconstruct several question numbers/tables; it was not the approval source.
signoff.secondPassMethod: Reopened all original question images in reverse order: 43,41,39,37,35,33,31,29,27,25,23,21,19,17,15,13,11,10,9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2. Compared every stem/statement/option with the manual modules. Same AI reviewer in a fresh pass, not independent human review. No original required diagram occurs in this paper. Matching tables, formulas, underlining and shared passage were explicitly compared.
signoff.classificationMethod: Reread the concept decisions against the full question and every alternative after original reconstruction. Validated existing leaf paths; split sleet/condensation, kept chronology and colonial local-government under bounded new subparts, corrected the industrial-revolution defence leaf, and classified tidal energy by tested concept rather than its position in the source paper. Primary placements remain distinct from source identity and answer verification.
newSyllabusBoundaries: History/Colonial Administration/Local self-government: colonial local boards and Ripon’s resolution, excluding independent India’s 73rd/74th amendments.
History/Constitutional Developments/Chronology of constitutional politics: comparative national-movement political milestones, excluding unrelated date trivia and ancient/medieval chronology.

Defence World History/Industrial Revolution/Phases and industries: phases and sectoral changes, excluding individual inventor biographies and labour-movement history. NDA/CDS only, not automatically CSE GS.
signoff.officialKeyReview: Direct UPSC four-page final PDF; Series A page 1 header and all 150 cells visually checked column-first then row-first. Programmatic comparison agrees exactly. Zero drops, zero multiple-answer cells. Retain official scoring despite academic disagreement with a printed premise or an answer.
signoff.releaseState: Source/editorial approval only; runtime, grading, local/browser/PDF and production release gates still required.
